topology.TopologyRevision: The positive revision of one Semantic Topology.

SemanticRelation.description: A Relation from one Concept to another Concept.

topology.Equivalent: Two Concepts express the same meaning for purposes of the topology.

Broader.description: The source Concept is semantically broader than the target.
Broader.derivation: the inverse view; not stored as a second Relation

topology.Related: The Concepts have a meaningful associative relationship without equivalence or hierarchy.
topology.CloseMatch: The Concepts are similar enough to map or retrieve, and not safe to treat as equivalent.
topology.Overlap: The Concepts share part of their meaning while each retains meaning the other does not contain.

SemanticTopology.description: One organization's current structure of meaning among its Concepts.

composition.law: Every SemanticRelation in a SemanticTopology has source and target Concepts in that topology.
A SemanticRelation's source and target are Concepts.
A Broader Relation does not relate a Concept to itself.
The directed Broader graph of a SemanticTopology is acyclic.
Equivalent does not merge or destroy either Concept's identity.
Absence of a SemanticRelation means undeclared, not false.
A SemanticRelation is asserted generally within its topology. Restriction to a Context is not a field of this module yet.
A proposed SemanticRelation is not part of a SemanticTopology until it is constructed into one.
A SemanticTopology does not rewrite the originating systems of the meanings it relates.

alignment.law: An ONTOK Concept may be projected as a SKOS Concept.
A SemanticTopology may be projected as a SKOS ConceptScheme.
Broader may be projected as skos:broader. narrower is the inverse view.
Related may be projected as skos:related.
Equivalent may be projected as skos:exactMatch.
CloseMatch may be projected as skos:closeMatch.
Overlap has no required SKOS property; it remains an ONTOK Relation unless a projection is chosen.
SKOS is an interchange vocabulary. It is not the ONTOK programming surface.
